# Case 1: no nodes in subset
{"nodes":[],"partition":[0,0,1,1],"refinedPartition":[0,0,1,1],"resolution":1.0,"gamma":1.0,"theta":0.01}
@ len(nodes) = 0 → function returns refinedPartition unchanged
{"partition":[0,0,1,1]}

# Case 2: single node in subset
{"nodes":[2],"partition":[0,0,1,1],"refinedPartition":[0,0,1,1],"resolution":1.0,"gamma":1.0,"theta":0.01}
@ len(nodes) = 1 → early return, refinedPartition unchanged
{"partition":[0,0,1,1]}

# Case 3: multiple nodes, but current implementation does not refine
{"nodes":[0,1,2,3],"partition":[0,0,1,1],"refinedPartition":[0,0,1,1],"resolution":1.0,"gamma":1.0,"theta":0.01}
@ len(nodes) > 1 but improved=false → loop never runs, refinedPartition unchanged
{"partition":[0,0,1,1]}

# Case 4: different refinedPartition, still unchanged
{"nodes":[0,2],"partition":[0,1,0,1],"refinedPartition":[0,0,2,2],"resolution":1.0,"gamma":1.0,"theta":0.01}
@ with current code, output must equal refinedPartition argument
{"partition":[0,0,2,2]}
